protocol.description: This optional protocol adds exact scheduling to ordinary wl_surface commits. Epoch and sequence are immutable identity; times are scheduling estimates in the wp_presentation clock domain.

request.name: set_target
request.description: The target is a scheduling constraint, not a client-liveness contract. If the identity is expired, unissued, from an inactive epoch, or regresses this surface, the next buffer commit is discarded and the previously accepted buffer remains current. These semantic misses never disconnect the client. Referencing an object owned by a different client remains a protocol error.
